headline: A 36-acre Godrej community off Bannerghatta Road.
pitch: Godrej Vanantara is at Hommadevanahalli, off Bannerghatta Road in South Bengaluru. It is a large gated community from a national builder, on the side of the city where the Pink Line has just opened.

reasons.title: The metro has just opened here
reasons.text: The Pink Line's elevated section from Kalena Agrahara to S.G. Palya (7.5 km, 6 stations) opened on 14 November 2026. Kalena Agrahara is on Bannerghatta Road.
reasons.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

reasons.title: It will reach MG Road and Nagawara
reasons.text: The rest of the Pink Line, underground to Nagawara, is expected around March to May 2027. At Nagawara it meets the airport line.
reasons.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

reasons.title: More metro is approved
reasons.text: The Orange Line (Kempapura to JP Nagar 4th Phase, 32.15 km) was approved by the Union Cabinet in August 2024.
reasons.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

reasons.title: Prices have moved up this year
reasons.text: Asking prices on Bannerghatta Road went from about ₹11,950 to about ₹12,450 per sq.ft. between December 2025 and June 2026.

upcoming.what: Pink Line metro (Kalena Agrahara to Nagawara)
upcoming.status: 21.25 km, 18 stations. The elevated Kalena Agrahara to S.G. Palya section opened on 14 November 2026. The underground section to Nagawara is expected around March to May 2027.
upcoming.why: Connects the Bannerghatta Road side to MG Road and on to Nagawara, where it meets the airport line.
upcoming.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

upcoming.what: Orange Line metro (Kempapura to JP Nagar 4th Phase)
upcoming.status: 32.15 km, 22 stations. Approved by the Union Cabinet in August 2024; scheduled completion 2031.
upcoming.why: A western ring of metro that links Hebbal, Peenya and JP Nagar without going through the centre.
upcoming.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

upcoming.status: 73 km ring road with a reported 2029 deadline.
upcoming.why: Takes through-traffic off the Outer Ring Road and shortens cross-city trips.

timeline.what: Pink Line opens to S.G. Palya

timelineSource: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026. Government target dates can move.
band: The first Pink Line trains started this month. Bannerghatta Road is no longer waiting for its metro.

area.name: Bannerghatta Road
area.source: Square Yards property rates page, read 26 Nov 2026. Asking prices from listings, not registered sale prices.
